ggsegverse: Easily Install and Load the 'ggsegverse' Brain Visualisation Ecosystem

Source: R/ggsegverse-package.R
ggsegverse-package.Rd

Installs and loads the core packages of the 'ggsegverse', an ecosystem for plotting brain atlases and mapping data onto brain regions in 2D and 3D, together with 'ggplot2', in a single call. Also provides helpers to find and install atlas packages, report package versions, and detect namespace conflicts. Learn more about the 'ggsegverse' ecosystem at https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggsegverse/.

Details

library(ggsegverse) attaches the core packages:

  • ggseg — 2D brain atlas plots with geom_brain().

  • ggseg3d — interactive 3D brain atlas widgets.

  • ggseg.formats — atlas data structures and the bundled dk(), aseg(), tracula(), and suit() atlases.

  • ggseg.meshes — additional cortical and cerebellar surface meshes.

  • ggplot2 — the plotting grammar ggseg builds on.

More atlases are available from the ggsegverse r-universe; see ggseg_atlas_repos() and install_ggseg_atlas(). To build your own atlases, install ggseg.extra separately.

Options

ggsegverse.quiet

Set to TRUE to suppress the startup message when loading ggsegverse. Default is FALSE.
